cause: The generated program called (orders/place {"subtotal" 100}) expecting a total of 120, but pricing.rule/apply-standard adds 2 instead of the documented 20 flat charge, causing the total to be 102 and the equality check to fail, triggering an explicit failure.
evidence: The generated source program: (let [quote (orders/place {"subtotal" 100})] (if (= (get quote "total") 120) quote (fail {:kind "order-total-mismatch"})))
